title: Why Speculative Decoding Works Better Than Predicted on Sparse MoE Models
summary: Routing overlap and GPU execution explain why measured speculative-decoding cost departs from activated-expert-byte estimates; an IPF model predicts unique experts with under 4% error. Ten sparse MoE models (30B–1T) plus H100 profiling and controlled synthetic routing support the mechanism; performance is hardware/workload specific.
